MLforSEO Academy · Introduction to Machine Learning for SEO

AI Meta Data Creator

Turn an article, or a CSV of pages, into three title tags, three meta descriptions and an H2/H3 outline each, with character counts so you can see what fits.

What you need
Your OpenAI API key
Cost
Paid OpenAI usage on your own key: well under a cent per article on GPT-6 Luna, roughly 3 to 6 cents on GPT-5.6 Sol
Feed it
Pasted article text and a target keyword, or a CSV with URL, Title and Content columns
You get back
Editable titles, meta descriptions and outlines to copy, and seo-metadata-generated.csv

How to use it

  1. Paste your OpenAI API key and pick a model. The key stays in this browser tab and goes only to OpenAI.
  2. For one page, paste the article text and enter the target keyword.
  3. For many pages, upload a CSV with URL, Title and Content columns and check the preview.
  4. Add the audience and content goal if you know them, then generate.
  5. Check the character counts, edit the wording, then copy or export.

Worth knowing. The model cannot search the web, so the competitor analysis is its guess at what ranks, not a live SERP. Check any gap it names against a real search before you act on it.

MLforSEO · Introduction to Machine Learning for SEO

AI Meta Data Creator

Turn an article, or a CSV of pages, into three title tags, three meta descriptions and an H2/H3 outline, with character counts so you can see what fits before you publish.

1 · Your API key and model

Your key stays in this browser tab and is sent only to OpenAI. It is not saved anywhere.
GPT-6 Luna costs roughly a fortieth of GPT-5.6 Sol per page. Try one article on each before a large CSV run.

2 · Your content

Paste one article, or upload a CSV of pages. Browsers cannot fetch other sites' pages, so the text comes from you or your crawler export.
The first line longer than eight characters is treated as the current title. Only the first 8,000 characters are sent.
The model cannot search the web. Competitor analysis is its informed guess at what ranks for your keyword and what those pages cover. Check it against a real search before acting on it.
Needs URL, Title and Content columns. One row per page.
An inferred list per row, not a live search. Slower, and each row costs a little more.
Add your key and some content to begin.

Your metadata

Title options aim for 50 to 60 characters

Meta descriptions aim for 150 to 160 characters

Heading outline ## is an H2, ### is an H3

Competitor analysis inferred by the model, not a live search

Edit any field before you copy it. Counts and tiles update as you type.

Results

Runs in your browser. Your key and content go only to OpenAI. MLforSEO Academy
